QuestInfo.name: The Nightmare
QuestInfo.0: Quietly place the report next to the sleeping Empress.
QuestInfo.1: As you were about to leave the report, you were again whisked away to a strange place, just like at the Deep Sea.
QuestInfo.2:
You saw the Empress and Future Empress inside the Empress's dream.
The Future Empress you heard from the rumors... Why would Cygnus have such a dream?

1.0: Thank you for waking me from my slumber. I was having the most horrendous nightmare...\r\n#L0##bWas it the Black Mage and his loonies? Don't you worry, Empress, your trusty knights have got it covered!#l\n#k
1.1: I wish to help you, but I am not yet strong enough... \r\n#L0##bDon't say that! You're a huge help! You're our Empress!#l\n#k
1.2: Please don't share my doubts with the other Knights...or with Neinheart. They'll only worry needlessly. As for Shinsoo... Ah, nevermind.

mob.0:
Is Cygnus havin' another one of her nightmares? Ye have to enter her dreams and help her!

(Forfeit then restart The Nightmare quest to reenter Cygnus's dream.)
